title: On Warning the travellers about the tide
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：warn　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 warn 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the ranger ① warned the travellers about the tide before dawn, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the ranger ② warns the travellers about the tide in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ warn the travellers about the tide at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ warned the travellers about the tide before — a line in the survey for October 1974 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Warning the travellers about the tide before dawn, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ warn the village a day beforehand in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Warn the village a day beforehand at once and never mention it again.

By 1987 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the survey, and a new villager from the next valley ⑧ warns the village a day beforehand before dawn every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ridge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ warned the travellers about the tide again when nobody else would.

⑩ To warn the travellers about the tide, my mother said in 1992, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody warns the travellers about the tide in public again and somebody must warn the travellers about the tide before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 警告（一般过去式 warned the travellers about the tide：1980 年守林人头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 警告（一般现在 warns the travellers about the tide：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 警告（不定式 to warn the travellers about the tide：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 警告（过去完成时 had warned the travellers about the tide：1974 年十月的踏勘记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 警告（动名词 warning the travellers about the tide 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 预先通知（warn the village a day beforehand：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去预先通知提前一天通知了全村）
G. v. 预先通知（warn the village a day beforehand：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 警告（后段两处：新来的村民照例 warns the village a day beforehand，而母亲又一次 warned the travellers about the tide）

answers.why: warn 意为“警告”，1980 年守林人天没亮就警告提醒旅人注意潮水，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 warned。
warn 意为“警告”，自那以后守林人当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 warns。
warn 意为“警告”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯警告提醒旅人注意潮水”，此处为不定式 to warn the travellers about the tide。
warn 意为“警告”，踏勘记录里 十月 那行字说明早在 1987 年之前就有人警告过，故用过去完成时 had warned。
warn 意为“警告”，守林人说“警告提醒旅人注意潮水这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 warning the travellers about the tide 作主语。
warn 意为“预先通知”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去预先通知提前一天通知了全村”，should ever 之后用原形 warn the village a day beforehand。
warn 意为“预先通知”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻预先通知提前一天通知了全村（warn the village a day beforehand at once），以后再也不要提起。
warn 意为“警告”，新来的村民每个季节都照例预先通知提前一天通知了全村，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 warns。
warn 意为“警告”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就警告提醒旅人注意潮水，用一般过去式 warned 叙述。
warn 意为“警告”，结尾那句是母亲 1992 年的话：要警告提醒旅人注意潮水，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，守林人天没亮就警告提醒旅人注意潮水；山谷里每一个村民都说这是头一回。（warned the travellers about the tide）
多年以后，守林人仍当着众人面做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（warns the travellers about the tide）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯警告提醒旅人注意潮水这件事本身。（to warn the travellers about the tide）
早在 1974 年就有人警告提醒旅人注意潮水，十月那天踏勘记录上的一行字就是证据。（had warned the travellers about the tide）
守林人说过，天没亮就警告提醒旅人注意潮水这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（warning the travellers about the tide 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻预先通知提前一天通知了全村，以后再也不要提起。（warn the village a day beforehand，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 warn 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the ranger warned the travellers about the tide before dawn, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the ranger warns the travellers about the tide in public whenever the valley asks.
Warning the travellers about the tide before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever warn the village a day beforehand in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new villager from the next valley warns the village a day beforehand before dawn every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother warned the travellers about the tide again, and the valley remembered that half.
